name: pinned-list-needle
body:
RECONCILIATION (implementation outcome; commit `e97891b2`). [with coordinator]

source: the brief said to "extend `acceptance_node_edge_surface_is_transparent_and_pinned_in_help_tools_and_agents` (the pinned list) to include the new `implementation-phase-reviewer.md`". This note originally assumed the new pin would MIRROR the existing `("agent-builder.md", "`apg_node`/`apg_edge`/`apg_plan_add`")` pair — i.e. keep that pair and add a matching reviewer pair.

inconsistency (found during implementation): the test's pinned structure is a list of `(agent-name, needle)` PAIRS (`let pinned: &[(&str, &str)]`), so a bare name is not expressible — the new entry needs a needle the reviewer prompt actually carries. Task-1 relocated the reviewer section out of `agent-builder.md` into the new distributed `opencode-suite/agents/implementation-phase-reviewer.md`, taking the authoring-tool vocabulary line (`no spec/plan authoring (`apg_node`/`apg_edge`/`apg_plan_add`)`) with it. The reviewer prompt is now the carrier of that needle; `agent-builder.md` no longer states it, so the original `("agent-builder.md", …)` pair would no longer pin anything and would fail the test.

resolution (shipped): the pin MOVED with the vocabulary rather than being mirrored. The pinned list now carries the pair `("implementation-phase-reviewer.md", "`apg_node`/`apg_edge`/`apg_plan_add`")` — the same needle, now carried by the reviewer prompt — and the stale `(agent-builder.md, …)` pair was DROPPED, not mirrored. `agent-builder.md` was deliberately NOT re-edited to re-state the vocabulary: the authoring-tool clause moved with the reviewer prompt, so re-adding it to the builder template would duplicate the moved line. The test's separate retired-surface loop already scans EVERY embedded AGENTS entry (including `agent-builder.md`) for retired surfaces, so that prompt remains covered there without the removed pin. [autonomous]
